# Test fixture media

Current image files are original geometric test placeholders generated by `scripts/release-sample-media.mjs` under MIT. They test animation frame selection and layout, not final art quality. Earlier illustrations, SD frames and generation records were preserved in an owner backup outside this repository. See `config/source-sample-media.json` for hashes. The ambience remains the original deterministic synthesis in `../tools/make-ambience.py`; no third-party recordings are used.
